top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Another Fed hike is on the horizon — but when?
top_signals.summary: Another hike from the U.S. Fed is on the way, after meeting minutes released Wednesday showed officials expect to increase interest rates before year-end.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
